propositions: The s3 doctor's _fold_heads function currently merges bundle heads into the worktree HEAD using git merge, causing the heal result to depend on the tracker's checked-out branch.
_require_tracker_on_ref guard refuses healing when the current branch differs from the published ref, preventing heals on detached HEAD or side-branch trackers.
The fold mechanism must be rewritten to use git merge-tree --write-tree and git commit-tree to fold into the published ref tip without requiring a worktree checkout.
After healing, the published ref must be moved via git update-ref (off-branch) or git reset --hard (on-branch) to keep index and worktree consistent when the ref is checked out.
The merge=ours driver policy for .bridge_state files must be preserved and tested when folding heads into the published ref.
